# SeEx v3.0.0

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 1. 请原谅我直接从 `v2.0.0` 跳到了现在的 `v3.0.0`。
> 2. 这个版本几乎完成了我立项以来所有的愿景。

## ✨ 新增

### Cadence（OrCAD Capture / Allegro）导出

- 新增第三个导出目标：`Cadence`，与 `Altium`、`KiCad` 并列。
- 导出 `Capture` 原理图符号：生成一个 `Library XML` 文件，在 `Capture` 中通过 `File > Import > Library XML` 转换为 `.olb`；立创 EDA 的多 part 符号会导出为同一个器件的多个 section。
- 导出 `Allegro` 封装：每个封装一个 `SKILL` 脚本，外加一个库脚本；在 `Allegro PCB Editor` 命令窗口执行 `skill load("<库>_allegro/<库>.il")`，即在同一目录生成 `.dra`、`.psm` 和 `.pad`。
- 导出 `3D` 模型（`step`），并在封装中按立创 EDA 的位置映射好模型。
- 标准封装（贴片阻容、`SOT`、`SOD`、`SOIC`、`QFN` 等）按 `IPC-7352` 计算焊盘并核对厂家焊盘；其余封装保留厂家焊盘，按 `IPC-7352` 规则生成丝印、装配层和占位区。
- `seex` 本身不调用任何 `Cadence` 程序，导入由用户在 `Cadence` 中完成。

### 3D 模型

- 默认去除 `3D` 模型上的立创 EDA 标志（水印）：重建模型本体，只保留纯色外壳。
- 无法安全去除时会保留原模型，并在导出结果中列出这些元件，便于人工确认。
- 可以在导出页关闭 “去除 3D 标志”，保留立创 EDA 的原始模型。

## 🚀 改进

- 导出页新增 `EDA` 目标选择（`Altium` / `KiCad` / `Cadence`）、`Cadence` 导出范围（`Capture` / `Allegro` / `3D`）和 “去除 3D 标志” 开关。
- `STEP` 模型下载总超时由 `60s` 提升到 `180s`，大模型在慢速线路上不再被误判为失败。
- `STEP` 模型下载在 `modules.lceda.cn` 不可用时，会自动回退到 `modules.easyeda.com` 镜像。
- `KiCad` 的符号/封装转换拆分为可复用的构建步骤，供 `Cadence` 复用；`KiCad` 输出保持不变。
- 元数据新增 `package` 与 `value` 字段，用于 `Cadence` 的封装与参数命名。
- 窗口不再默认置顶；需要时点 `PIN`（`置顶`）按钮即可。
- 依赖升级：`tokio` 1.54.1、`resvg` 0.49.0。
- 文档：README 改版（徽章、界面预览、导出示例），并补充了新的 `KiCad` 示例图。

## 🐞 修复

- 选择导出目录后不立即生效的问题：现在文件夹选择框一关，导出目录就会立刻更新，不必重启 `seex`。此前选择的结果其实已经写入配置，但界面上的输入框没有跟着刷新，下一次编辑又把旧路径写了回去，所以看起来像是“重启后才生效”。
- `BOM CSV` 的选择框走同一条路径，也一并修好了。

## ⚠️ 行为变化

- `3D` 模型默认不再带立创 EDA 标志。**旧库不会自动更新**，需要重新导出才会得到去除标志的模型。
- 想要保留原始 `3D` 模型，请在导出页关闭 “去除 3D 标志”。
- `Cadence` 目标需要本机安装 `Cadence SPB 26.1`（OrCAD X Capture / Allegro X）；`Allegro` 封装脚本需要支持 `SKILL` 的版本（`Allegro PCB Designer` 或 `OrCAD PCB Designer Professional`）。

# SeEx v3.0.0 (English)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 1. Apologies for skipping directly from `v2.0.0` to `v3.0.0`.
> 2. This release fulfills nearly all the original visions since the project initiation.

## ✨ Added

### Cadence (OrCAD Capture / Allegro) export

- A third export target: `Cadence`, alongside `Altium` and `KiCad`.
- `Capture` schematic symbols: one `Library XML` file, converted to an `.olb` inside `Capture` with `File > Import > Library XML`; multi-part EasyEDA symbols become sections of a single Capture part.
- `Allegro` footprints: one `SKILL` script per footprint plus one library script; `skill load("<library>_allegro/<library>.il")` in the `Allegro PCB Editor` command window builds the `.dra`, `.psm` and `.pad` files in that folder.
- `3D` models (`step`), mapped into the footprint at the position EasyEDA uses.
- Standard packages (chip resistors and capacitors, `SOT`, `SOD`, `SOIC`, `QFN`, ...) get `IPC-7352` lands checked against the manufacturer's; other packages keep the manufacturer's lands, with silkscreen, assembly layer and place bound generated per `IPC-7352`.
- `seex` runs no Cadence program itself; the import is done inside `Cadence`.

### 3D models

- The EasyEDA logo (watermark) is removed from `3D` models by default: the body is rebuilt as a plain, solid part.
- When the logo cannot be removed safely the original model is exported and those components are listed in the export result, so they can be checked by hand.
- The removal can be turned off with the "Remove 3D logo" toggle on the export page, keeping the original EasyEDA models.

## 🚀 Improvements

- The export page gains an `EDA` target selector (`Altium` / `KiCad` / `Cadence`), a `Cadence` scope (`Capture` / `Allegro` / `3D`) and a "Remove 3D logo" toggle.
- `STEP` download timeout raised from `60s` to `180s`, so a large model on a slow route is no longer treated as a failure.
- `STEP` downloads fall back to the `modules.easyeda.com` mirror when `modules.lceda.cn` is unreachable.
- The `KiCad` symbol and footprint conversion is split into reusable build steps that `Cadence` reuses; `KiCad` output is unchanged.
- Metadata gains `package` and `value`, used for `Cadence` footprint and parameter naming.
- The window no longer opens always-on-top; use the `PIN` button when you want it.
- Dependencies: `tokio` 1.54.1, `resvg` 0.49.0.
- Docs: restyled README (badges, screenshots, export examples) and new `KiCad` showcase images.

## 🐞 Fixed

- Choosing an export folder now takes effect immediately: the export directory updates as soon as the folder dialog closes, with no restart. The choice was already being saved to the config, but the box on screen never refreshed and wrote its old text back on the next edit, so it looked like a setting that only applied after relaunching.
- The `BOM CSV` box goes through the same path and is fixed with it.

## ⚠️ Behaviour changes

- `3D` models no longer carry the EasyEDA logo by default. **Existing libraries are not updated automatically** — re-export them to get logo-free models.
- To keep the original `3D` models, turn off "Remove 3D logo" on the export page.
- The `Cadence` target needs a local `Cadence SPB 26.1` install (OrCAD X Capture / Allegro X); the `Allegro` footprint scripts need a release that supports `SKILL` (`Allegro PCB Designer` or `OrCAD PCB Designer Professional`).
